channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: যাত্রাবাড়ীতে মাদকবিরোধী অভিযানে হামলা, ২৬ আসামি কারাগারে
item.description: রাজধানীর যাত্রাবাড়ীতে মাদকবিরোধী অভিযানের সময় আইনশৃঙ্খলা বাহিনীর ওপর হামলার ঘটনার পর গ্রেপ্তার হওয়া ২৬ জনকে আদালত কারাগারে পাঠানোর আদেশ দিয়েছেন। ওই সংঘর্ষে পুলিশ সদস্যরা আহত হয়েছিলেন।

item.title: উখিয়ায় গভীর নলকূপের গ্যাস আগুন টানা চার দিন ধরে জ্বলছে
item.description: কক্সবাজারের ইনানীতে একটি গভীর নলকূপ স্থাপনের সময় ভূগর্ভ থেকে উদ্ভূত গ্যাসে লাগা আগুন টানা চার দিন ধরে জ্বলছে। পেট্রোবাংলা পনেরো দিন পর্যবেক্ষণের পর সেখানে রিলিফ কূপ খননের পরিকল্পনা হাতে নিয়েছে।

item.title: Canelo and Mbilli weigh in safely ahead of Riyadh fight
item.description: Saul 'Canelo' Alvarez and Christian Mbilli successfully weighed in for their world championship match in Riyadh, only a day after two ballistic missiles were intercepted above Saudi Arabia's capital.

item.title: Pakistan military hopeful about US-Iran diplomatic talks
item.description: A spokesperson for the Pakistani military stated they are cautiously optimistic regarding mediation efforts between the US and Iran, while cautioning that influential adversaries still benefit from ongoing hostilities.

item.title: Guntur readies 596 booths for November 1 civic elections
item.description: Guntur and Tenali have arranged 596 polling booths for over 775,000 voters to cast ballots on November 1. Ballots will be tallied on November 3 at Acharya Nagarjuna University and VSR College respectively.

item.title: Suvendu challenges Abhishek to run in 2029 general election
item.description: Suvendu has challenged Abhishek to contest the 2029 Lok Sabha election from Diamond Harbour. This follows comments where the MP alleged political targeting and warned specific police personnel against acting on orders.

item.title: Karnataka police mourn second officer from same batch
item.description: Karnataka has experienced the death of a second police officer from the same academy batch within a span of two months. The two deceased officers were close friends.

item.title: Ex-IAS officer sends legal notice over midnight fireworks
item.description: A retired IAS officer suffering from respiratory issues served a legal notice to Karnataka police for not enforcing the apex court's nighttime prohibition on loud fireworks between 10 p.m. and 6 a.m.

item.title: Akhilesh Yadav claims U.P. CM focused on home district during MLC elections
item.description: Following the release of the final MLC election results on Thursday, the BJP secured six of the eleven contested seats. Meanwhile, the SP increased its seat count by two compared to the prior elections.

item.title: South coastal Andhra Pradesh expects moderate rainfall over three days
item.description: The IMD reports that an Andaman Sea low-pressure zone may form a Bay of Bengal depression by October 31. This system is forecasted to approach the coast of Andhra Pradesh within the subsequent two days.

item.title: ISRO Prepares GSLV-F18 Mission for NVS-03 Satellite Deployment
item.description: The Indian Space Research Organisation is preparing to send up the GSLV-F18 rocket carrying the NVS-03 navigation satellite.

item.title: ISRO successfully deploys the NVS-03 satellite
item.description: Weighing 2,250 kg, the NVS-03 marks the third spacecraft in the upgraded navigation series. It aims to maintain ongoing navigation services for the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System.

item.title: A.P. allocates ₹3,000 crore to upgrade Godavari irrigation drains
item.description: The Chief Minister announced that upgrading irrigation drains will permanently resolve crop flooding issues. He also noted that Cyclone Arnab enabled the diversion of 4.68 TMC of rainwater to reservoirs.

item.title: Introduction of Home Nursing Aid program focused on elderly care
item.description: A new training program titled Home Nursing Aid has been introduced specifically for elderly care.

item.title: Significance of the ISRO NVS-03 satellite mission
item.description: This mission aims to revive India's NavIC regional navigation network. Development of the system began after the 1999 Kargil War due to restricted U.S. GPS data access.

item.title: High court asks for update on Pakistani-born teenager and Indian father
item.description: The High Court has requested a status report regarding the reunion of a deported Pakistani-born teenager with an Indian father located in Jammu and Kashmir.

item.title: Gagandeep Singh Bedi leads review for Greater Chennai Corporation
item.description: He directed municipal officials to inspect commercial businesses that supply single-use plastic items.

item.title: Mirfield native and Star Trek icon Sir Patrick Stewart receives honors
item.description: Acclaimed actor Sir Patrick Stewart, originally from the town of Mirfield, has recently been the recipient of widespread public praise and tributes.

item.title: Academic staff protest alleged police mistreatment of MIDS scholar
item.description: Faculty members at MIDS have formally spoken out against what they describe as harassment of professor Kalaiyarasan by law enforcement.

item.title: Canada and the European Union form a new international partnership
item.description: During a summit in Montreal, Canadian and European leaders launched an open alliance designed to navigate global instability and foster cooperation.

item.title: Israeli forces raze homes of Palestinians accused of soldier assault
item.description: The military destroyed properties linked to individuals blamed for attacking soldiers, detaining about 12 people while thousands stay displaced in Hebron.

item.title: ইসরায়েলে নেতানিয়াহুবিহীন সরকার গঠনে বিরোধী দলগুলোর আলোচনা
item.description: ইসরায়েলি নির্বাচনে কোনো দল একক সংখ্যাগরিষ্ঠতা না পাওয়ায় বর্তমান প্রধানমন্ত্রী বেনিয়ামিন নেতানিয়াহুকে ক্ষমতাচ্যুত করতে বিরোধীরা আলোচনা চালিয়ে যাচ্ছে। ১২০ সদস্যের নেসেটে সরকার গঠনে প্রয়োজনীয় ৬১ আসন কারও নেই।

item.title: Top court requests Election Commission update on Form 7 grievances
item.description: Following a Congress parliamentarian's fraud claims during the SIR process, the Supreme Court asked the ECI for a status report regarding Form 7 use.

item.title: Oman's forces save 25 individuals from ablaze vessel in Hormuz Strait
item.description: Omani authorities successfully evacuated 25 people from a burning petroleum carrier in the Strait of Hormuz amid regional tensions over navigation routes.

item.title: Prime Minister Modi accuses political rivals of spreading disorder
item.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that opposition parties are attempting to create societal chaos during a period of worldwide economic turmoil.

item.title: Chennai Youth Participate in Inktober Challenge
item.description: Young artists in Chennai are actively engaging in Inktober this month. They are posting their daily drawings and personal interpretations of the art challenge across social media.

item.title: VIS Under-15 Football Finale Set for October 31 with ₹2.25 Lakh Prize
item.description: The ultimate match of the VIS Under-15 Football Tournament is scheduled for October 31. Organizers announced a total reward pool of ₹2.25 lakh for the competing teams.

item.title: Zverev Eliminates Fery to Secure Vienna Open Semifinal Berth
item.description: Newly positioned at the top of the global rankings, Alexander Zverev advanced to the Vienna Open semifinals following a decisive win against British player Arthur Fery.

item.title: Alaska political contender refutes involvement in alleged double-candidate scheme
item.description: Current Republican Senator Dan S. Sullivan and his supporters claim political opponents enlisted Dan J. Sullivan as a candidate to mislead voters in Alaska. The challenger, however, maintains he had no knowledge of any coordinated effort to place two similarly named individuals on the ballot.

item.title: শ্রমিক মজুরি বোর্ড গঠনে রোববার আসছে সরকারি ঘোষণা
item.description: পোশাক খাতের শ্রমিকদের ন্যূনতম মজুরি নির্ধারণের লক্ষে আগামী রোববার নতুন একটি বোর্ড গঠিত হতে যাচ্ছে। শ্রমিক জোটের নেতাদের সঙ্গে আলোচনা শেষে শ্রমমন্ত্রী আরিফুল হক চৌধুরী শুক্রবার এ তথ্য জানান।

item.title: Everything you need to know about Googlebooks
item.description: As reported by Engadget, Despite good initial hardware, the Googlebook OS still needs a lot of work. Key points: Everything, Googlebooks Despite, Googlebook, everything.

item.title: Leased forest land at Athirappilly in Keralam to be surveyed amid disputes over blocking elephant corridor
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, Forest department strongly opposes Plantation Corporation, Kerala’s proposal to renew the lease agreement and access more land, citing violation of lease conditions, including engaging private agencies for pineapple farming on the holding. Key points: Leased, Athirappilly, Keralam, Forest.

item.title: 'It's win or lose. No draw tomorrow': Rickelton anticipates gripping final day
item.description: As reported by ESPNcricinfo, Australia need 287 runs, South Africa need ten wickets, and the series is set for a fascinating conclusion. Key points: Rickelton, Australia, South Africa, tomorrow.

item.title: Floral plants and native food products on display at Siri Sasyothsava
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, Floral plants and native food products on display at Siri Sasyothsava. Key points: Floral, Siri Sasyothsava Floral, Siri Sasyothsava, floral.

item.title: Isro’s NVS-03 launch successful: Navigation satellite placed in orbit; NavIC gets a boost
item.description: As reported by Times of India, GSLV-F18 carrying 2,250kg next-generation navigation satellite -- NVS-03 -. Key points: Isro, Navigation, Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota.

item.title: Kerala Crime Branch Arrests R. Hari Over PSC Exam Scam
item.description: Authorities detained R. Hari, an additional secretary for the PSC, following allegations tied to a disputed State Planning Board test evaluation. Hari had evaded capture since the recent arrest of former deputy secretary P. Satheesh.

item.title: জেনিফার লরেন্স শুটিংয়ে অস্বস্তিকর অভিজ্ঞতার মুখোমুখি
item.description: অস্কারজয়ী অভিনেত্রী জেনিফার লরেন্স অতীতে একটি দৃশ্যের চিত্রায়ণের সময় বহিরাগতদের উপস্থিতিতে অস্বস্তিতে পড়েছিলেন। শুটিংয়ের ওই অভিজ্ঞতা নিয়ে তিনি পরবর্তীতে অসন্তোষ প্রকাশ করেন।

item.title: UP Chief Electoral Officer Issues Strict Voter List Guidelines
item.description: The Uttar Pradesh electoral chief instructed staff to keep voter registries precise and current. Personnel were strictly forbidden from disclosing confidential access details like IDs, passwords, and OTPs to others.

item.title: Karnataka Shuts Down Seven Bottled Water Facilities
item.description: Authorities in Karnataka shuttered seven packaged drinking water plants following safety infractions. Officials checked 102 facilities over a two-day period and gathered 69 water specimens for testing.

item.title: Young Man's Remains Exhumed Close to Pazhaverkadu
item.description: Law enforcement authorities excavated the corpse of a young male near the Pazhaverkadu area. Investigations into the circumstances surrounding the burial are currently underway.

item.title: Tasmac Updates Beverage Rates and Implements Bottle Deposit
item.description: Tasmac adjusted alcoholic beverage rates starting November 1 by adding an environmental surcharge to various drinks. Consumers who bring back empty bottles will receive a ten-rupee reimbursement.

item.title: Budget Vehicles Move Off Lots Faster Than Earlier This Year
item.description: Market figures reveal that low-cost automobiles are clearing inventory at an accelerated pace compared to early year levels. Nonetheless, select budget categories experienced reduced sales during the third quarter.

item.title: Google Spaceborne AI Server Sends Initial Reply to Earth
item.description: A Google satellite carrying artificial intelligence hardware successfully processed and sent its maiden response from orbit. The company reported on Friday that activating its onboard TPU chips enabled the Gemma 4 model to execute a prompt.

item.title: Police detain 108 students for alcohol use at Chevella; four positive for narcotics
item.description: Law enforcement raided a farmhouse in Chevella where they found 108 students consuming alcoholic beverages. Medical screenings conducted during the operation confirmed that four of the individuals had also used marijuana.

item.title: হাতিয়ায় পুলিশের ওপর হামলা চালিয়ে হত্যা মামলার আসামিকে ছিনিয়ে নিল জনতা
item.description: নোয়াখালীর হাতিয়ায় শুক্রবার সন্ধ্যায় একটি হত্যা মামলার আসামিকে গ্রেপ্তার করতে গিয়ে বাধার মুখে পড়ে পুলিশ। স্থানীয় বাসিন্দা ও স্বজনরা আইনশৃঙ্খলা রক্ষাকারী বাহিনীর সঙ্গে ধস্তাধস্তিতে লিপ্ত হয়ে অভিযুক্ত ব্যক্তিকে পালিয়ে যেতে সাহায্য করে।

item.title: Kim Jong Un demands North Korean dominance in unmanned aerial technology
item.description: The North Korean leader has called for the country to achieve absolute superiority in its drone production and operational capabilities. This directive emphasizes the strategic importance of advancing the nation's robotic aviation systems.

item.title: কিলিয়ান এমবাপ্পেকে নিয়ে চীনে ইন্টারনেটে রহস্যময় সেন্সরশিপ ও ধোঁয়াশা
item.description: ফুটবল তারকা কিলিয়ান এমবাপ্পের প্রতি চীনের নাগরিকদের ক্ষোভের কারণ নিয়ে দেশটির ইন্টারনেট ব্যবহারকারীরা বিভ্রান্তিতে পড়েছেন। তথ্যের ওপর কড়াকড়ি থাকায় অনেক ব্যবহারকারী কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা বা সাংকেতিক ভাষার মাধ্যমে এই বিতর্কের উৎস খোঁজার চেষ্টা করছেন।

item.title: Kate Winslet joins literacy drive by narrating children's story online
item.description: Actress Kate Winslet recently read the book 'Room on the Broom' for the Storyline Online digital library. The project uses celebrity narrations to promote reading habits in children through stories focused on themes like cooperation and kindness.

item.title: ISRO launches NVS-03 satellite to upgrade India's NavIC navigation infrastructure
item.description: The Indian Space Research Organisation successfully sent the NVS-03 satellite into orbit to support the domestic NavIC system. In addition to improving civilian navigation, the craft carries an atomic clock to provide highly precise timing services.

item.title: Nasdaq drops to eight-week low amid massive artificial intelligence expenditures
item.description: Shares in major American technology companies, including Intel, saw a sharp decrease as investments in AI approached $1 trillion. This market downturn resulted in the tech-focused Nasdaq index reaching its lowest point in more than two months.

item.title: Satlyt achieves milestone in developing space-based virtual data centers
item.description: The company Satlyt successfully finished a trial this month aimed at repurposing satellites for data storage and processing. This test brings the firm closer to its goal of establishing a network of functional computing centers in orbit.

item.title: Binance Works to Recover $6.3B Tied to North Korean Breach
item.description: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance is trying to retrieve $6.3 billion lost in a major cyber intrusion. The firm calls the sophisticated breach the largest of its type.

item.title: Bombay High Court Rejects Defamation Lawsuit Filed by Palash Muchhal
item.description: The Bombay High Court threw out a defamation lawsuit brought by composer Palash Muchhal against Vidnyan Mane, an associate of Smriti Mandhana. Mane, who previously alleged financial fraud by Muchhal, now intends to pursue criminal action.

item.title: Sahara Meteorite Offers Insight Into Early Martian Crust
item.description: Researchers have identified a scarce meteorite discovered in the Sahara desert as a fragment of early Mars. The rock provides scientists a glimpse into the planet's primordial surface layer.

item.title: Zest Launches Text-Based AI Assistant for Dining Plans
item.description: Startup Zest has introduced an artificial intelligence agent designed to coordinate group dining choices via text messages. The tool aggregates preferences, facilitates voting, and secures restaurant bookings.

item.title: Colombian Budget Reductions Target Transitional Justice Tribunal
item.description: Colombian leadership intends to reduce funding for a specialized tribunal handling transitional justice matters. This fiscal plan has raised serious concerns among survivors of war crimes.

item.title: False Claims on Social Media Blame Muslims for French Church Fires
item.description: Anti-immigrant social media profiles spread unverified claims that French Muslims torched five churches during nationwide demonstrations on October 17. Authorities confirmed the entire report is entirely fabricated.

item.title: City of London Leader Named First on UK Black Powerlist
item.description: Ian Thomas, the chief administrator of the City of London Corporation, has secured the top spot on the 21st annual Black Powerlist.

item.title: ISRO Launches NVS-03 Navigation Satellite from Sriharikota
item.description: India's space agency successfully launched the NVS-03 navigation satellite aboard a GSLV-F18 rocket. Liftoff occurred at 11:51 p.m. IST on Friday from the Sriharikota space center's second pad.

item.title: জাপান ও বাংলাদেশের সম্পর্ক জোরদার হয়েছে: প্রতিমন্ত্রী কবীর
item.description: প্রধানমন্ত্রী তারেক রহমানের চারদিনের টোকিও সফরে উন্নয়ন অংশীদারত্ব বজায় রাখার প্রতিশ্রুতি দিয়েছে জাপান। পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্রী হুমায়ুন কবীর জানান, এর মাধ্যমে মানবসম্পদ উন্নয়ন ও বেসরকারি বিনিয়োগের সুযোগ তৈরি হয়েছে।
